# Native speech source and licenses

Sherpa-ONNX1.13.8 release source and its pinned eSpeak/Piper source ZIPs are retained here. The two dependency ZIP hashes were checked against the release CMake manifests. The complete OnKlav Rust bridge is core/speech; source/host/mobile artifacts are guarded by docs/speech-native-provenance.json. Runtime/model archive URLs and hashes are in docs/speech-dependencies.json; model/data file hashes are in the included voice manifest. Licenses/notices are packaged under android/shared/src/main/assets/licenses.

Sherpa/model: Apache2.0. Piper-phonemize source: MIT. eSpeak NG/data: GPL3.0 or later. ONNX Runtime: MIT. The linked phonemizer distribution is subject to eSpeak's GPL; do not describe the combined native engine as Apache-only. OnKlav already documents GPL3 combined-distribution and corresponding-source obligations for NewPipe; preserve this speech source kit and the complete OnKlav sources/notices with distributed builds as well.

For source rebuilding, unpack sherpa-onnx-1.13.8.tar.gz, place the pinned dependency ZIPs in its source directory (the supplied CMake files recognize these filenames), and follow its Android build scripts/CMake recipes. Use NDK27.2.12479018, android29, arm64-v8a, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON, SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_C_API=ON, SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_TTS=ON, SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_PORTAUDIO=OFF and16KiB maximum page alignment. The release source contains the dependency recipes/build scripts; other upstream dependency downloads may be needed. Third-party C API source rebuilding/bit-for-bit reproduction was not executed in this turn: official pinned prebuilt C API/ORT release binaries were used, and the OnKlav Rust bridge was actually built/tested for host and Android ARM64. Changing any prebuilt library intentionally requires updating its documented hash and requalification; do not mix1.13.8 and2.0 binaries.
